keyword: charlotte hornets vs miami heat timeline
claims: The Charlotte Hornets defeated the Miami Heat 127-126 in overtime on April 14, 2026.
The game was the 9th-vs-10th place Eastern Conference NBA Play-In Tournament game.
LaMelo Ball made the go-ahead layup with 4.7 seconds left in overtime.
Miles Bridges blocked Davion Mitchell's shot at the buzzer.
Miami forced overtime in the 4th quarter.
Brandon Miller hit a 3-pointer to pull within 112-111 late in the 4th quarter.
Coby White scored 14 points in the 3rd quarter, including four 3-pointers.
The Hornets led 89-83 after the 3rd quarter.
The Charlotte Hornets secured the No. 9 seed with a 44-38 record.
The Miami Heat were the No. 10 seed with a 43-39 record.
The Charlotte Hornets hosted the Miami Heat.
The Charlotte Hornets advanced to play the loser of the 7th-vs-8th matchup.
